rationale: Frozen corrected D0 case-2 PR #290 proved that one authoritative publication can be selected for multiple planner evidence requirements in a single scenario resolution, but publication-backed materialization reused immutable certified evidence IDs for each requirement and violated the EvidenceResolverOutput global evidence-ID uniqueness invariant before reasoning could run. Repair requirement-scopes runtime EvidencePackage identity while retaining the immutable certified evidence ID and authoritative publication receipt in provenance.
supersession_impact: No publication, certification, planning, reasoning, or answer capability is superseded. Existing publication admission and semantic content remain unchanged; only runtime materialized evidence identity is made requirement-safe.
authority_impact: No new insurance fact, applicability, eligibility, claim-payment, or recommendation authority is introduced. The repair changes identity/provenance mechanics only and preserves the authoritative publication and certified evidence lineage used to justify each runtime package.
